tools.name: get_field_note
tools.description: Read a specific field note article by slug or topic (params: slug — defaults to first note) -> {slug, title, meta, url, summary, full_text}

tools.name: get_solution_overview
tools.description: Get operational workflow, workspace capabilities, and quality criteria for advertisers or publishers (params: role='advertiser'|'publisher') -> {role, headline, capabilities, quality_features}

role.description: Role to inspect: 'advertiser' for buying demand, 'publisher' for supply monetization. Defaults to 'advertiser'.

tools.name: list_field_notes
tools.description: Browse published research, compliance, and lead quality field notes (params: topic) -> list [{slug, title, category, read_time, url}]

topic.description: Optional topic or category keyword to filter articles by (e.g. 'quality', 'consent', 'insurance', 'solar')

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List active consumer demand markets, categories, and routing rules on Qentrax (params: category) -> list [{id, name, description, categories}]

category.description: Optional vertical or category keyword to filter by (e.g. 'insurance', 'solar', 'real estate', 'finance')

tools.name: send_contact_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a partnership or demand inquiry to the Qentrax network team (params: name, email, message) -> {status, name, email, message, confirmation}

name.description: Full name of the contact person

message.description: Details about goals, verticals, and current demand/traffic workflow
